# DSH More
English | 简体中文
Practical, independently switchable patches for missing context and history controls in DeepSeek Har
, independently switchable patches for missing context and history controls in DeepSeek Harness Web.
`dsh-more` integrates with the existing DSH interface instead of adding a separate management dashbo
ard. Its current patch set can edit a user message and restart from that point, remove one message w
hile preserving the surrounding context, and permanently delete a session while leaving native archi
surrounding context, and permanently delete a session while leaving native archive behavior intact.
> **Compatibility:** the development/test baseline is DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`. All patches and
existing peer ranges are preserved. Type, feature and isolated Host checks pass against the target
RC; Windows path/build/script fixes are not a claim of Windows Desktop end-to-end verification. Node
.js 24+ is recommended; the package engine also allows Node.js 22.19+.
## Features
| Patch | Where it appears | Behavior | Default |
| Edit and restart | User-message action row | Creates a clean continuation before the selected turn

, submits the edited text, archives the source branch, and opens the child session | On |
| Delete o
ne message | User- and assistant-message action rows | Removes the selected model-surface node, expa
nds only when tool call/result pairing requires it, rebuilds the surviving context, and opens a chil

d session | On |
| Permanently delete session | Separate item beside the native Archive action | Sto
ps and unloads the target session, removes its exact JSONL persistence directory, detaches it from w

orkspaces, and synchronizes the lists incrementally | On |
| Model capabilities | Settings → Models
→ Model capabilities | Configure image support, selectable thinking types and parameter formats per

model | On |
| Fast mode | Composer toolbar and `/fast` | Toggle faster model service for the curren

t session (may consume quota faster) | On |
| Markdown export | Conversation toolbar / More menu | E

xport messages and tool results with Windows-safe download filenames | On |
| Automatic titles | Aft

er the first request | Generate a title using the current model, preserving manual names | On |
| In
dependent tasks and grouping | Workspace picker / session menu | Create an independent task with its
draft intact; group sessions without changing their working directories | On |
Patch switches live under **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → DSH More** and take effect w
ithout rebuilding the plugin.
### Requirements

- Node.js `>= 24`
- A working `dsh` CLI and a Web or Desktop profile on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2

`
- Access to the npm registry that publishes `dsh-more`
pnpm is needed only when installing or developing from source. For a published release, use the DSH
plugin command so the package is installed into the selected DSH profile; do not install it globally
with `npm install -g`.
### Configure model capabilities
Open **Settings → Models**, expand a saved provider with **Edit**, and click **Model capabilities**
s → Models**, expand a saved provider with **Edit**, and click **Model capabilities** below a model:

1. **Vision**: inherit defaults, support images, or accept text only.
2. **Thinking types**: inherit
defaults, disable reasoning, or choose supported levels (off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhig

h / max) and their API parameter values.
3. **Thinking parameter format**: expand the advanced optio
n to select an installed DSH format such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen or OpenRouter. This applies to Op
enAI Completions compatible interfaces; other protocols use native dispatch.
**Save** writes the model's `input` (`[text, image]` or `[text]`), `reasoningEfforts`, and `compat.t
hinkingFormat` under `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models[]` in `settings.yaml`. DSH applies the chan
ges through its live settings mechanism.
Each setting independently offers **Inherit defaults**, removing that model declaration and using DS
H's catalog, provider configuration or adapter defaults. Missing declarations do not prove support:
unknown models normally default to text input with no selectable thinking levels. A custom reasoning
list needs at least one non-off level. The off parameter may be blank or use an explicit API value.

## Architecture

## Compatibility notes
See the desktop verification record for the actual macOS `0.1.7-rc.2` window checks. The desktop ada
pter navigates through `uiWorkspace.openSession()`, reads current selection from `retainedBy.mainVie
w`, and temporarily retains newly created Sessions until their drafts can be transferred. Independen
t tasks, edit/delete handoffs, and current-session deletion share this adapter.
Development uses the pinned `0.2.1-rc.2` SDK; Host peer ranges preserve existing RC/alpha compatibil
ity. The removed `webRuntime` service is no longer required; requests use the authenticated Connecti
on Fetch registry. Settings adapters support ConfigForms/SettingsForms and the previous APIs. The ad
apters and tests cover the current session format, message provenance, `main.conversation` slot, and
JSONL persistence snapshots and location capability. For an existing local linked install, rebuild,
restart DSH, and reload the page to load both the new Host and Client.
- The current test baseline is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; future pre-release API or DOM changes can require a
dapter updates. Run `pnpm run test:runtime` for isolated RC Host integration checks (temporary profi

le and fake model; no user history or credentials).
- In-product DSH More copy is currently primaril
y Simplified Chinese, although native Copy/Archive selectors recognize both Chinese and English labe

ls.
- Message actions operate only on ordinary user messages and assistant messages still present in

the current model surface; editing requires a completed owning turn.
- Permanent deletion requires
a `jsonl` backend with a valid location capability. Its current `locate` hook is internal; the adapt

er checks its presence and result. Tests cover plain and Zstandard-compressed session files.
- Unloa
ding a live session uses tracked public Agent handles. Passive tracking spans the plugin lifetime, i
ncluding periods when deletion is disabled, and preserves the caller's Cordis ownership. A live writ
er that predates the plugin's observation is still refused with a restart instruction, preserving wr
ite ownership and file locks.
